blind.description: A wooden trestle table covered with a green tablecloth, laden with trade goods. The items on top include two tied burlap sacks, two red clay/terracotta storage jars with lids, a stack of folded red-and-beige striped blankets, a small dark lantern, a coiled rope or pastry ring, an open wooden stave bucket, and a round yellow cheese wheel. The model features clean, stylized, hand-painted continuous geometry with no floating or broken parts.
blind.from_above: A dense rectangular arrangement atop green fabric: a row containing a tied sack, two circular jar lids, and folded striped cloth, alongside a second row with a sack, an open circular ring/coil, a square lantern top, an open circular bucket interior, and a round yellow cheese wheel.
blind.height_vs_figure: About waist-high to the 5 ft 9 in figure (around 2.5 to 3 ft tall) and roughly 4.5 to 5 ft wide along its main length.
blind.flame_or_glow: slight warm yellow tint on the lantern panes
